{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
completed['revenue_float'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed['revenue_float'].mean()

# Final check: ensure no QA orders or refunded orders remain
qa_in_completed = completed[completed['revenue'] == '999999.99']
refunded_in_completed = completed[completed['status'] == 'refunded']

print(f'QA orders in completed set: {len(qa_in_completed)}')
print(f'Refunded orders in completed set: {len(refunded_in_completed)}')
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
